about: Round PROG1 (Karl, 2 Nov 2026: "add ways to make progression more tangible and 'fun' JRPG style"; the design is the Project doc claude/HANDOVER_PROGRESSION_2026-11-02.md). The Adventure's progression numbers, one file so Karl tunes them without code. EVERY value is a placeholder (Claude's estimate, 3 Nov 2026) until prog-tune measures them. results: how the screen after a duel plays out, in seconds. card_quality (Round PROG1b; it was meter, the deck-power meter, and a file with meter still reads): the Card quality line - change_seconds the +0.1 shows, decimals, and explain, the one line saying what it is (Karl to edit). rpg/progress.py checks this file when it is read and names any key it can't use. Round PROG2: rewards - how many cards each reward card is a choice of (choices_per_card); boss - whether a boss gives the 'Guards:' card he holds on top of his reward cards; chests - each treasure chest's contents by its id (the map's chest marker names it): gold (a number), card ("band": a card from the region's tier band in your deck's colours), pack (a set code with a pack pool, opened at once), gear (Round PROG4: a piece's id in rpg/data/gear.json, given once; a number - PROG2's file - is that much gold), daily (true: it fills again at refill_hour each in-game morning; otherwise it opens once). Round PROG3: xp - XP a duel gives by kind of foe when won (regular, dungeon, rare, boss), a quest handed in (quest), a lost or conceded duel (loss) and a draw (draw). levels - the curve: level 2 at 'first' XP, each next level needs 'step' more than the last; 'cap' the highest level; every level above 1 adds life_per_level to the duel's starting life (base_life at level 1); every perk_every-th level deals a choice of perk_choices perks. perks - each perk's name, text (what the choice says), stackable (offered again once taken), available (false: never offered - the game can't do it yet; why_not says why) and effect: reward_choices (+N cards per reward pick), gold_bonus (a share added to a win's gold), loss_cut (Round GOLD1: how much smaller a loss is - 0.25 takes a quarter less of numbers.json's share for that kind of fight; it was loss_share, a share instead of numbers.json's), life / hand (added to the duel's start), battlefield (cards on your battlefield at the start; token:SCRIPT is one of Forge's token scripts), gear_slot (Round PROG4: Pack Mule - the Pack slot opens, rpg/data/gear.json). rpg/levels.py reads and checks these. Round PROG5 (Karl's answer 10, "All four"; rpg/extras.py reads and checks these): first_win - the gold and XP the first won duel of each in-game day adds (the clock's Day N). bounties - the board in Lantern Hollow: slots jobs at a time, one new job each in-game day; each job's text (what the clerk says), goal (quests.json's words: {"beat": kind, "count": n}; or {"win": n} with "phase" (won at night: "night") or "map" (won on one of these maps, | between them)) and reward (gold, xp, card: "colours" - a card of the region's band your deck can cast). trade_up - the card shop's Trade up: copies of one card for 1 random card a tier higher in your colours; past_band false keeps it inside the region's band (region 1: 1 -> 2 and 2 -> 3). gauntlet - the town gauntlet: its entry fee, how many duels, the regular foe kinds it draws from, and prizes by wins (gold, xp, pack: one of the town's packs, card: rare_from_band); its duels pay no foe's gold or cards, and a loss there takes no gold. Round SPAR1 (Karl, 3 Nov 2026: "B as its own task after prog-tune"; rpg/spar.py reads and checks these): sparring - the sparring yard in Lantern Hollow: duels, how many practice duels a spar plays (Forge's AI on both seats: your deck, level and gear against this region's regular foes); max_duels, the most a spar may be; timeout, seconds before a practice duel is a draw; against, each region's words for its foes in the result ("Won 26 of 40 against the moor's foes"). A spar gives no gold, cards or XP and moves no clock. Karl 4 Nov 2026, after the 8 h soak (claude/PROG_TUNE_OVERNIGHT_2026-11-04.md): xp is doubled (tools/rpg_soak_settings/xp_x2: regular 20, dungeon 40, rare 60, boss 120, quest 50, loss 4); the first win of the day's, the bounties' and the gauntlet's XP are as before (xp_x2 left them alone).
